title: Event envelope
description: Wrapper of every event published by any service. The event-specific payload is in 'data' and has its own schema under <source>/<eventType>.schema.json.

eventId.description: Unique per event. Consumers store processed ids to drop duplicate deliveries (SQS is at-least-once).

eventType.description: English PascalCase name, also sent as the SNS message attribute 'eventType'.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the 'data' schema for this event type.
